data.label:
Get-Content coord/STATE.md | Select-Object -First 3
Write-Output "---"
(Select-String -Path coord/STATE.md -Pattern '^## 20').Count
Select-String -Path coord/STATE.md -Pattern 'S1920: paper-level' | ForEach-Object { $_.LineNumber.ToString() + ': ' + $_.Line }
Select-String -Path coord/STATE.md -Pattern 'S1964' | ForEach-Object { $_.LineNumber.ToString() + ': ' + $_.Line.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(70,$_.Line.Length)) }
Write-Output "---"
(Get-Item coord/STATE.md).Length
